definitions.explanation: The inside of a building or enclosed space. Used as a noun or as a modifier (屋内の) to describe things located or happening indoors.

examples.japanese: {屋内|おくない}で{遊|あそ}ぼう。
{雨|あめ}なので{屋内|おくない}プールに{行|い}った。
examples.english: Since it was raining, we went to the indoor pool.

examples.japanese: この{施設|しせつ}は{屋内|おくない}が{全面|ぜんめん}{禁煙|きんえん}になっている。
examples.english: This facility is entirely non-smoking indoors.

notes: The opposite of {屋外|おくがい} (outdoors). Composed of {屋|おく} (roof, building) + {内|ない} (inside). Commonly used as a modifier: {屋内|おくない}プール (indoor pool), {屋内|おくない}{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう} (indoor parking lot), {屋内|おくない}{競技|きょうぎ} (indoor sports). More formal than {中|なか} (inside) and specifically refers to being inside a building, not just any enclosed space.
